thread:
Iris (PM): Quick ask after todays all-hands: can leadership give a short, actionable north star for the next two quarters? Folks keep pinging my team for prioritization.

Leah (CEO): North star: make LLM inference trivial to operate at scale. Concretely: reduce unpredictable tails and give customers clear cost controls. Two immediate bets: (A) lower-latency, predictable Hosted experience for devs; (B) hardened Dedicated offering for customers needing SLAs and isolation.

Harper (GTM): How should sales frame this to prospects who already use cloud-managed endpoints?

Leah (CEO): Frame it as: "we're the serving layer you can rely on"	6 predictable latency and real cost knobs vs an endpoint that behaves like a black box. Emphasize migration path and measurable SLOs.

Marcus (Head of Product): Product priorities: publish a compact perf+cost cheat sheet, roll out a POC playbook (Hosted -> Dedicated), and ship a docs appendix that explains where our runtime advantage matters.

Zoe (Eng Lead): Engineering blockers for Dedicated deals: (1) autoscale behaviors that respect 99p SLOs, (2) tenant-level cache controls, (3) safer model rollouts across heterogeneous GPU pools. We can do these but need prioritization.

Theo (Research): I'll own the perf+cost cheat sheet. Plan: three representative models, two hardware profiles, p50/p95/p99 numbers, and rough $/1000 token guidance. Need infra runs next week.

Marcus (Head of Product): Great. I'll make the POC playbook template and partner with GTM on acceptance criteria. Target: draft in 10 business days.

Harper (GTM): For quota and comp: suggestion to add a one-time AE bonus for converting Hosted trial -> Dedicated commit within 90 days. Will propose to RevOps.

Leah (CEO): Sounds reasonable. Harper, loop in RevOps and FP&A; we'll pilot.

Iris (PM): Any direction on messaging tone? technical vs business?

Leah (CEO): Two-tier messaging: the landing page and docs should be technical and quantitative for engineers; marketing/headline copy should be outcome-first for buyers (reliability, predictable spend).

Zoe (Eng Lead): Ops ask: can product prioritize the three infra items as an "A-list"? We can schedule dedicated sprints if it's high priority.

Marcus (Head of Product): Yes. Marking as A-list. Creating a working epic and will invite Zoe and Theo.

notify-bot: Reminder set for #product in 48h to post the working epic and invite lists.

Harper (GTM): I'll pin a short POC checklist example to the board: handshake steps, perf validation, security signoff, and go/no-go criteria.

Theo (Research): One competitive note: some open runtimes beat us on raw throughput for very narrow configs. We should document where our end-to-end stack (routing + caching + rollouts) yields better results in real apps.

Leah (CEO): Add that to the docs appendix. Also, if anyone has specific competitor notes from deals, drop them on the board or DM me.

Iris (PM): Summary of immediate actions: Theo -> perf cheat sheet; Marcus -> POC playbook + epic; Zoe -> infra acceptance criteria; Harper -> AE incentive proposal; Docs -> "why Redwood" appendix. I'll capture and assign.

Leah (CEO): Thanks everyone. We'll review progress at the next all-hands and in the working board. If you want to join the working group reply here.

Marcus (Head of Product): Board created: https://rwd.internal/boards/INF-FOCUS-1787 (internal link).

Zoe (Eng Lead): joining the group.

Harper (GTM): adding initial POC notes to the board now.

Iris (PM): closing thread. :white_check_mark:
